svg.title: Where X.509 fits in an HTTPS request
svg.desc: The API presents its X.509 certificate and intermediates. The client checks the trust chain, hostname and validity, and verifies proof of private-key control. After TLS succeeds, the API verifies the JWT using the issuer's signing public key.

g.text: Where X.509 fits in an HTTPS request
1 · API PRESENTS ITS CERTIFICATE DURING TLS
Contains api.example.com, the server public key and validity dates
The API also sends any needed intermediate certificates
Checks the chain to a trusted CA, the hostname and the validity dates
The handshake proves the server controls the corresponding private key
3 · Client sends the bearer JWT over the established TLS connection
Uses the issuer’s trusted JWT signing public key
